title: Resolution urging Albany to curb 'vulture fund' debt lawsuits
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.5623/A.5290, which would tighten the state's anti-champerty law to stop so-called vulture funds from profiting off distressed foreign government debt. The bill would remove the current safe harbor for debt purchases over $500,000 and require creditors to negotiate in good faith when the International Monetary Fund deems a foreign nation's debt unsustainable.
